doc.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025

title: Goodman and Glenn Miller biopics
summary: They both enjoy The Benny Goodman Story and The Glenn Miller Story, and Bennett says he loved Miller before Goodman.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: I assume you watched “The Benny Goodman Story” with Steve Allen?
Me too, and “The Glenn Miller Story.” And I mean Glenn Miller’s band, the LPs is what first got my attention as a kid I think. But you know that they’re Hollywood-ized but they’re fun nonetheless.
Totally. I mean I’m a huge Glenn Miller fan. In fact I think Glenn was on my radar before I heard Benny. You know, so I love all that stuff. A lot of good memories.
